ground: i do think if a PR didnt cause a pre-existing problem, it's like this, outside this change, but potentially a bonus.

miss.note: Rule Before 2 did not say whether an unchanged line under a line the change adds is among the lines it touches; the recommender and one blind assessor read it as touched and answered problem, the other blind assessor could not tell for that reason, and the user ruled the older fault outside this change in the third asking, after asking twice what the pull request promised.

lesson.says: A fault is in the lines the change touches only when it is on a line the change adds, removes or rewrites; an older fault on an unchanged line is outside the review unless the change says it fixes it.
